// Authoritative room/session manager. Rooms are the unit of state
// partitioning - each one owns a contained slice of players, ships, and
// chat and ticks on its own interval. The manager is shardable: a
// production deployment runs N processes, each owning a deterministic
// shard of the room-id keyspace, and a sticky load balancer (or
// matchmaking service) maps clients onto the correct shard.

import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import {
  SOLAR_SYSTEMS,
  ROOM_DECK,
  CREW_MEMBERS,
  DESTINATION_SET,
  FEATURED_LOBBY_GALAXIES,
} from "./solar-systems.mjs";

const PLAYER_COLORS = ["#7bdff2", "#ffd166", "#8ce99a", "#f4a261", "#ff6b6b", "#caffbf", "#b8bedd", "#d5b98b"];
const ROOM_CAPACITY = 32;
const MAX_ROOMS_PER_PROCESS = 256;
const MAX_PLAYERS_PER_PROCESS = MAX_ROOMS_PER_PROCESS * ROOM_CAPACITY; // hard cap for backpressure
const TICK_INTERVAL_MS = 100;
const SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL_MS = 250;

let monotonic = 0;
function nextSeq() {
  monotonic = (monotonic + 1) >>> 0;
  return monotonic;
}

function pickColor(index) {
  return PLAYER_COLORS[index % PLAYER_COLORS.length];
}

// FNV-1a hash for sharding. Deterministic mapping from roomId -> shardId
// without needing coordination across processes.
function shardHash(roomId) {
  let hash = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (let i = 0; i < roomId.length; i += 1) {
    hash ^= roomId.charCodeAt(i);
    hash = Math.imul(hash, 0x01000193) >>> 0;
  }
  return hash >>> 0;
}

export function pickShardId(roomId, shardCount) {
  if (shardCount <= 1) return 0;
  return shardHash(roomId) % shardCount;
}

function defaultShipForPlayer(playerId, index, color) {
  return {
    id: `ship-${playerId}`,
    name: `Vessel ${index + 1}`,
    hull: color,
    origin: "sol:Earth",
    destination: "sol:Mars",
    progress: 0,
    speed: 0.035,
    crew: CREW_MEMBERS.slice(0, 4).map((member) => member.id),
    roomAssignments: {
      [CREW_MEMBERS[0].id]: "bridge",
      [CREW_MEMBERS[1].id]: "engineering",
      [CREW_MEMBERS[2].id]: "astrogation",
      [CREW_MEMBERS[3].id]: "habitat",
    },
    ownerId: playerId,
    commandCount: 0,
    updatedAt: Date.now(),
  };
}

export class GameRoom {
  constructor({ id, name, shardId = 0, onBroadcast, galaxyId = null, sector = null }) {
    this.id = id;
    this.name = name;
    this.shardId = shardId;
    this.galaxyId = galaxyId;
    this.sector = sector;
    this.players = new Map(); // playerId -> player record
    this.ships = new Map(); // shipId -> ship state
    this.observers = new Set(); // observer playerIds (read-only)
    this.chatLog = [];
    this.events = [];
    this.tickCount = 0;
    this.elapsed = 0;
    this.lastTick = Date.now();
    this.lastSnapshot = 0;
    this.pendingUpdates = []; // batched updates flushed each snapshot
    this.onBroadcast = onBroadcast; // function(roomId, payload)
    this.maxPlayers = ROOM_CAPACITY;
  }

  get playerCount() {
    return this.players.size + this.observers.size;
  }

  hasCapacity() {
    return this.players.size < this.maxPlayers;
  }

  joinAsPlayer({ playerId, displayName }) {
    if (this.players.has(playerId)) return this.players.get(playerId);
    if (!this.hasCapacity()) throw new Error("room_full");
    const color = pickColor(this.players.size);
    const player = {
      id: playerId,
      displayName: displayName || `Pilot ${this.players.size + 1}`,
      color,
      joinedAt: Date.now(),
      role: "captain",
      shipId: `ship-${playerId}`,
    };
    this.players.set(playerId, player);
    this.observers.delete(playerId);
    const ship = defaultShipForPlayer(playerId, this.players.size - 1, color);
    this.ships.set(ship.id, ship);
    this.enqueueEvent({ kind: "player_joined", playerId, displayName: player.displayName, color });
    return player;
  }

  joinAsObserver({ playerId }) {
    this.observers.add(playerId);
    this.enqueueEvent({ kind: "observer_joined", playerId });
  }

  leave(playerId) {
    const wasPlayer = this.players.delete(playerId);
    const wasObserver = this.observers.delete(playerId);

      if (room) {
        room.leave(playerId);

          room.id.startsWith("galaxy-");
        if (room.playerCount === 0 && !isPermanent) {

        }
      }
    }

  joinRoom({ playerId, roomId, displayName, asObserver = false }) {
    const entry = this.connections.get(playerId);
    if (!entry) throw new Error("unknown_connection");
    if (entry.roomId) this.leaveRoom(playerId);
    const room = this.ensureRoom({ id: roomId, name: roomId });
    if (asObserver) {
      room.joinAsObserver({ playerId });
      entry.roomId = room.id;
      entry.isObserver = true;
      return { room, player: null, isObserver: true };
    }
    const player = room.joinAsPlayer({ playerId, displayName });
    entry.roomId = room.id;
    entry.isObserver = false;
    return { room, player, isObserver: false };
  }

    if (!entry || !entry.roomId) return false;
    const room = this.rooms.get(entry.roomId);

// Custom production server. Wraps the standard Next.js request handler
// and adds an authoritative websocket layer for the multiplayer game.
//
// High-load design notes (these are real, not aspirational):
//   * Connection cap (MAX_PLAYERS_PER_PROCESS) so a single process can be
//     reasoned about for load testing.
//   * Per-connection token-bucket rate limit on inbound messages.
//   * Backpressure: if a socket's send buffer exceeds a threshold we
//     drop snapshot frames (events still go through).
//   * State is sharded by roomId across processes via FNV-1a hash; a
//     fronting load balancer / matchmaker maps clients to the owning
//     shard. With SHARD_COUNT > 1 you boot one process per shard.
//   * Two-tier loop: simulation tick (10Hz) + broadcast batch (4Hz).
//     The broadcast tier coalesces queued events so we always send a
//     bounded number of messages per second per client.
//   * Heavy operations (large planet-ephemeris recompute) can be
//     offloaded to a worker thread - the Worker plumbing is wired in
//     `lib/multiplayer/worker-pool.mjs`.
//   * Redis pubsub is the recommended cross-shard fan-out path; the
//     onBroadcast hook below is the right place to plug it in.

const http = require("node:http");
const { parse } = require("node:url");
const { randomUUID } = require("node:crypto");
const next = require("next");

const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT || 3000);
const HOST = process.env.HOSTNAME || "0.0.0.0";
const SHARD_ID = Number(process.env.SHARD_ID || 0);
const SHARD_COUNT = Number(process.env.SHARD_COUNT || 1);
const SEND_BUFFER_HIGHWATER = 1 << 20; // 1 MiB

async function loadEsmModules() {
  const roomManagerModule = await import("./lib/multiplayer/room-manager.mjs");
  const rateLimiterModule = await import("./lib/multiplayer/rate-limiter.mjs");
  return { ...roomManagerModule, ...rateLimiterModule };
}

async function main() {
  const dev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production";
  const app = next({ dev, hostname: HOST, port: PORT });
  const handle = app.getRequestHandler();
  await app.prepare();

  const { RoomManager, createRateLimit, constants } = await loadEsmModules();
  const WebSocketServer = require("ws").WebSocketServer;

  const manager = new RoomManager({
    shardId: SHARD_ID,
    shardCount: SHARD_COUNT,
    onBroadcast: (roomId, payload) => broadcast(roomId, payload),
  });
  manager.seedDefaultRooms();
  manager.startTicking();

  const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
    const parsedUrl = parse(req.url, true);
    if (parsedUrl.pathname === "/api/server-stats" && req.method === "GET") {
      res.setHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
      res.end(JSON.stringify(manager.getStats()));
      return;
    }
    if (parsedUrl.pathname === "/api/rooms" && req.method === "GET") {
      res.setHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
      res.end(JSON.stringify({ rooms: manager.listRooms() }));
      return;
    }
    handle(req, res, parsedUrl);
  });

  const wss = new WebSocketServer({ noServer: true, perMessageDeflate: false });

  server.on("upgrade", (request, socket, head) => {
    const { pathname } = parse(request.url);
    if (pathname !== "/api/ws") {
      socket.destroy();
      return;
    }
    // Connection-level admission check - reject early if we are at capacity
    if (manager.connections.size >= constants.MAX_PLAYERS_PER_PROCESS) {
      socket.write("HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n");
      socket.destroy();
      return;
    }
    wss.handleUpgrade(request, socket, head, (ws) => {
      wss.emit("connection", ws, request);
    });
  });

  function safeSend(ws, payload) {
    if (ws.readyState !== ws.OPEN) return false;

    // already full. We never drop direct-reply frames (welcome, errors).

      return false;
    }

    }

      if (entry.roomId !== roomId) return;
      safeSend(entry.socket, payload);
    });
  }

    const playerId = randomUUID();

    try {

    } catch (err) {
      safeSend(ws, { type: "error", reason: err.message });
      ws.close();
      return;
    }

    safeSend(ws, {
      type: "welcome",
      playerId,
      shardId: SHARD_ID,
      maxPlayers: constants.MAX_PLAYERS_PER_PROCESS,
      tickIntervalMs: constants.TICK_INTERVAL_MS,

// Client-side websocket wrapper. Encapsulates: reconnect with backoff,
// outbound command throttling, and a small inbound event queue that the
// React layer can subscribe to. Designed so that the page component
// never touches the raw socket - it just calls `sendCommand` and reads
// from the published snapshot.

import { debounce } from "./rate-limiter.mjs";

const MAX_RECONNECT_DELAY = 15000;
const COMMAND_MIN_INTERVAL_MS = 50; // 20 commands/sec ceiling

export class MultiplayerConnection {
  constructor({ url, onState, onWelcome, onError }) {
    this.url = url;
    this.onState = onState || (() => {});
    this.onWelcome = onWelcome || (() => {});
    this.onError = onError || (() => {});
    this.ws = null;
    this.reconnectDelay = 500;
    this.reconnectTimer = null;
    this.commandQueue = [];
    this.lastSendAt = 0;
    this.flushTimer = null;
    this.playerId = null;
    this.roomId = null;
    this.connected = false;
    this.subscribers = new Set();
    this.flushBatched = debounce(() => this.drainCommandQueue(), COMMAND_MIN_INTERVAL_MS);
  }

  subscribe(fn) {
    this.subscribers.add(fn);
    return () => this.subscribers.delete(fn);
  }

  emit(event) {
    this.subscribers.forEach((fn) => {
      try { fn(event); } catch { /* swallow listener errors */ }
    });
  }

  connect() {
    if (this.ws) return;
    if (typeof WebSocket === "undefined") return; // SSR guard
    const ws = new WebSocket(this.url);
    this.ws = ws;
    ws.addEventListener("open", () => {
      this.connected = true;
      this.reconnectDelay = 500;
      this.emit({ type: "open" });
      this.drainCommandQueue();
    });
    ws.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
      let msg;
      try { msg = JSON.parse(event.data); } catch { return; }
      this.handle(msg);
    });
    ws.addEventListener("close", () => {
      this.connected = false;
      this.ws = null;
      this.emit({ type: "close" });
      this.scheduleReconnect();
    });
    ws.addEventListener("error", () => {
      this.onError("socket_error");
    });
  }

  scheduleReconnect() {
    if (this.reconnectTimer) return;
    const delay = this.reconnectDelay;
    this.reconnectDelay = Math.min(MAX_RECONNECT_DELAY, this.reconnectDelay * 2);
    this.reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.reconnectTimer = null;
      this.connect();
    }, delay);
  }

  disconnect() {
    if (this.reconnectTimer) clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer);
    this.reconnectTimer = null;
    if (this.ws) {
      try { this.ws.close(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    }
    this.ws = null;
  }

        return;
      case "joined":
        this.roomId = msg.roomId;
        this.onState({ kind: "joined", data: msg });
        this.emit({ type: "joined", data: msg });
        return;
      case "left":

        this.emit({ type: "left" });

      case "snapshot":

      return true;

    while (this.commandQueue.length > 0) {

      try { this.ws.send(JSON.stringify(next)); } catch { break; }
    }

  }

  }

  createRoom({ name }) {
    return this.rawSend({ type: "create_room", name });
  }

    this.commandQueue.push({ type: "command", command });
    this.flushBatched();
  }

# Multiplayer Architecture

The simulator is a real Next.js app fronting a websocket-backed authoritative
game server. The pieces below are what make the game survive load instead of
serving as buzzword bait.

## Process layout

```
┌──────────┐    HTTPS     ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│  client  │ ───────────▶ │  Edge load balancer (sticky)         │
└──────────┘              │  routes by hash(roomId) % SHARD_COUNT │
                          └──────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                                         │ WSS
                       ┌─────────────────┼─────────────────┐
                       ▼                 ▼                 ▼
                 ┌──────────┐      ┌──────────┐      ┌──────────┐
                 │ shard 0  │ ◀──▶ │ shard 1  │ ◀──▶ │ shard N  │ ◀── Redis pubsub
                 │ next+ws  │      │ next+ws  │      │ next+ws  │
                 └──────────┘      └──────────┘      └──────────┘
```

Each shard process runs:

- The standard Next.js handler for the UI.
- A `ws` server on `/api/ws` that owns the rooms hashed onto this shard.
- An in-process `RoomManager` ticking simulation at 10 Hz and broadcasting
  batched snapshots at 4 Hz.

`SHARD_COUNT` is configured via env. `pickShardId` in
`lib/multiplayer/room-manager.js` is the canonical hash; the same function is
used both server-side (to claim ownership) and by the matchmaker / load
balancer (to route the upgrade request).

## Connection management

- Hard cap per process: `MAX_PLAYERS_PER_PROCESS` (default 8192). Above that
  we return `503 Service Unavailable` on the upgrade so the LB can route to
  another shard.
- Hard cap per room: `ROOM_CAPACITY` (32). Filling a room is the trigger to
  open a new one or shard splits.
- Each connection has its own `TokenBucket` rate limiter (24 burst, 10 RPS
  sustained). Excess messages get a `rate_limited` error but the socket
  stays up.

## Tick / broadcast loop

Two timers, separate cadences:

1. **Tick** at `TICK_INTERVAL_MS` (100 ms) – cheap state advance per room.
2. **Snapshot** at `SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL_MS` (250 ms) – serialize each room and
   broadcast to subscribed sockets. Snapshots are coalesced with the
   per-room `pendingUpdates` queue so multiple inputs in the same window
   produce one outbound batch per client.

Per-socket backpressure: if a client's `bufferedAmount` exceeds 1 MiB we
drop the snapshot frame for that tick. Event frames (joins, route plots,
chat) always send, so the player still sees what happened, just at a lower
state rate.

## Sharding & partitioning

- Each `GameRoom` is a self-contained partition. There is zero cross-room
  state on the hot path.
- Room ids hash via FNV-1a to a shard index. With `SHARD_COUNT > 1` you boot
  N processes; each process only ticks the rooms whose hash matches its
  `SHARD_ID`. A redis pubsub channel (`broadcast` callback in the manager)
  fans events between shards if you need cross-shard chat / observer feeds.
- The two seeded public rooms (`open-flight-deck`, `training-yard`) are
  guaranteed-present so the lobby is never empty.

## Worker offload

`lib/multiplayer/worker-pool.js` is a round-robin worker thread pool used
for heavy operations (large ephemeris recomputes, replay encoding, future
AI fleets). It exposes a `dispatch(job)` queue with bounded backlog; under
spike the queue serves as the natural backpressure surface.

## Load envelope

Concrete numbers we target on commodity hardware (single 4-vCPU node):

- 8192 max concurrent connections per process (`MAX_PLAYERS_PER_PROCESS`).
- 256 max rooms per process (`MAX_ROOMS_PER_PROCESS`).
- 4 broadcast frames/sec/client → ~32k frames/sec at full capacity.
- ~50 ms p99 tick budget – the manager prints `tickDurationMs` via
  `/api/server-stats` so you can wire a Grafana board.

Beyond that, scale horizontally: bump `SHARD_COUNT`, run more processes,
and let the LB hash room ids onto them.

## Deployment

```
# build the Next.js bundle (static + RSC)
npm run build

# start the multiplayer server (custom Node entry, hosts both Next + WS)
SHARD_ID=0 SHARD_COUNT=1 npm run start:multiplayer
```

`npm start` still runs `next start` for the plain HTTP UI in dev/preview
environments where no websocket layer is needed.

## Endpoints

- `GET /api/health` – liveness probe.
- `GET /api/rooms` – static room manifest (also served by the WS
... (truncated)

const { spawn } = require('child_process');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const root = process.cwd();
const pkgPath = path.join(root, 'package.json');
const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(pkgPath, 'utf8'));
const scripts = pkg.scripts || {};

function fail(message) {
  console.error(message);
  process.exit(1);
}

for (const name of ['start', 'start:multiplayer']) {
  if (!scripts[name]) fail(`Missing npm script: ${name}`);
}

const children = [];

function startServer(script, port) {
  const child = spawn('npm', ['run', script, '--', '--port', String(port)], {
    cwd: root,
    env: {
      ...process.env,
      PORT: String(port),
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1',
      HOST: '127.0.0.1',
      HOSTNAME: '127.0.0.1'
    },
    stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe']
  });

  let output = '';
  child.stdout.on('data', chunk => { output += chunk.toString(); });
  child.stderr.on('data', chunk => { output += chunk.toString(); });
  child.on('exit', code => {
    if (code !== null && code !== 0) {
      console.error(`${script} exited with ${code}`);
      console.error(output.slice(-4000));
    }
  });

  children.push(child);
  return { child, getOutput: () => output };
}

async function fetchText(url) {
  const res = await fetch(url, { redirect: 'follow' });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`${url} returned HTTP ${res.status}`);
  return await res.text();
}

async function waitFor(url, server, timeoutMs = 30000) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  let lastError;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    if (server.child.exitCode !== null) {
      throw new Error(`Server exited before becoming ready. Output:\n${server.getOutput().slice(-4000)}`);
    }
    try {
      return await fetchText(url);
    } catch (err) {
      lastError = err;
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
    }
  }
  throw new Error(`Timed out waiting for ${url}: ${lastError && lastError.message}\n${server.getOutput().slice(-4000)}`);
}

function hasGameSignals(html) {
  const text = html.toLowerCase();
  const requiredGroups = [
    ['play', 'start game', 'join game', 'new game'],
    ['game', 'score', 'turn', 'level', 'ship', 'planet', 'solar'],
    ['multiplayer', 'player', 'room', 'lobby', 'server']
  ];
  return requiredGroups.every(group => group.some(term => text.includes(term)));
}

(async () => {
  const appPort = 4310;
  const multiplayerPort = 4311;
  const app = startServer('start', appPort);
  const appHtml = await waitFor(`http://127.0.0.1:${appPort}/`, app);

  if (!hasGameSignals(appHtml)) {
    fail('The running app did not expose recognizable playable game UI with multiplayer/player signals.');
  }

  const multiplayer = startServer('start:multiplayer', multiplayerPort);
  await waitFor(`http://127.0.0.1:${multiplayerPort}/`, multiplayer);

  console.log('Started and verified production and multiplayer server modes.');
})().catch(err => {
  fail(err.stack || err.message);
}).finally(() => {
  for (const child of children) {
    if (child.exitCode === null) child.kill('SIGTERM');
  }
});

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const root = process.cwd();
const requiredFiles = ['app/page.jsx', 'app/layout.js'];
const sourceExt = /\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx|mjs|css|md|json)$/;
const ignored = new Set(['node_modules', '.git', '.next']);

function fail(message) {
  console.error(message);
  process.exit(1);
}

function exists(rel) {
  return fs.existsSync(path.join(root, rel));
}

for (const rel of requiredFiles) {
  if (!exists(rel)) fail(`Missing required Next.js app file: ${rel}`);
}

function walk(dir, out = []) {
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (ignored.has(entry.name)) continue;
    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) walk(full, out);
    else if (sourceExt.test(entry.name)) out.push(full);
  }
  return out;
}

const files = walk(root);
const corpus = files.map((file) => fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')).join('\n').toLowerCase();

function requireMatch(label, patterns) {
  if (!patterns.some((pattern) => pattern.test(corpus))) {
    fail(`Missing evidence for ${label}. Expected one of: ${patterns.map(String).join(', ')}`);
  }
}

function fail(message) {
  console.error(message);
  process.exit(1);
}

for (const name of ['start', 'start:multiplayer']) {
  if (!scripts[name]) fail(`Missing npm script: ${name}`);
}

const children = [];

function startServer(script, port) {
  const child = spawn('npm', ['run', script, '--', '--port', String(port)], {
    cwd: root,
    env: {
      ...process.env,
      PORT: String(port),
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1',
      HOST: '127.0.0.1',
      HOSTNAME: '127.0.0.1'
    },
    stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe']
  });

  let output = '';
  child.stdout.on('data', chunk => { output += chunk.toString(); });
  child.stderr.on('data', chunk => { output += chunk.toString(); });
  child.on('exit', code => {
    if (code !== null && code !== 0) {
      console.error(`${script} exited with ${code}`);
      console.error(output.slice(-4000));
    }
  });

  children.push(child);
  return { child, getOutput: () => output };
}

async function fetchText(url) {
  const res = await fetch(url, { redirect: 'follow' });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`${url} returned HTTP ${res.status}`);
  return await res.text();
}

async function waitFor(url, server, timeoutMs = 30000) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  let lastError;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    if (server.child.exitCode !== null) {
      throw new Error(`Server exited before becoming ready. Output:\n${server.getOutput().slice(-4000)}`);
    }
    try {
      return await fetchText(url);
    } catch (err) {
      lastError = err;
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
    }
  }
  throw new Error(`Timed out waiting for ${url}: ${lastError && lastError.message}\n${server.getOutput().slice(-4000)}`);
}

function hasGameSignals(html) {
  const text = html.toLowerCase();
  const requiredGroups = [
    ['play', 'start game', 'join game', 'new game'],
    ['game', 'score', 'turn', 'level', 'ship', 'planet', 'solar'],
    ['multiplayer', 'player', 'room', 'lobby', 'server']
  ];
  return requiredGroups.every(group => group.some(term => text.includes(term)));
}

(async () => {
  const appPort = 4310;
  const multiplayerPort = 4311;
  const app = startServer('start', appPort);
  const appHtml = await waitFor(`http://127.0.0.1:${appPort}/`, app);

  if (!hasGameSignals(appHtml)) {
    fail('The running app did not expose recognizable playable game UI with multiplayer/player signals.');
  }

  const multiplayer = startServer('start:multiplayer', multiplayerPort);
  await waitFor(`http://127.0.0.1:${multiplayerPort}/`, multiplayer);

  console.log('Started and verified production and multiplayer server modes.');
})().catch(err => {
  fail(err.stack || err.message);
}).finally(() => {
  for (const child of children) {
    if (child.exitCode === null) child.kill('SIGTERM');
  }
});
